description: The bar chart illustrates the performance ratio (in percentage) of three large language models—Llama3 (blue), Qwen2 (red), and ChatGPT (yellow)—across three distinct domains: Movies, Songs, and Basketball. The vertical axis represents the ratio (%) ranging from 50 to 90, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis categorizes the domains, with each domain featuring a grouped set of three bars corresponding to the models. In the Movies category, Llama3 and Qwen2 both achieve approximately 90%, while ChatGPT scores around 73%. In Songs, Llama3 scores about 84%, Qwen2 reaches 90%, and ChatGPT is at approximately 62%. For Basketball, Llama3 scores around 67%, Qwen2 drops to about 58%, and ChatGPT is at roughly 61%. The chart visually emphasizes that Qwen2 performs strongest in Movies and Songs, while Llama3 leads in Basketball; ChatGPT consistently underperforms relative to the other two models across all categories. The legend at the top clearly identifies each model by color, and the bars are arranged in consistent groupings per category, with no sorting applied across categories.
